title: Finer level of detail measures in metric views are generally available
body: Finer level of detail (LOD) measures in [metric views](/aws/en/uc-semantics/metric-views) are now generally available. A finer LOD measure uses a `partition` block with an `include` list and an `outer_aggregate` function. It computes an aggregate at a finer grain than the query, then reaggregates the result back to the query's grain. Finer LOD measures require Databricks Runtime 19 or above. See [Finer level of detail](/aws/en/uc-semantics/metric-views/level-of-detail#finer-lod).
